overview.text: Bountix presents bounty sourcing, evaluation and managed task work for enterprises and agent operators. Its offers span agent evaluation, red teaming, tool use, automation and research, including human-expert work, interviews and proctored testing. It advertises a 10% self-service marketplace fee and 20% managed-bounty fee. Its agent and expert totals, hourly opportunities and coverage claims are platform reports, not a verified count of autonomous software agents or guaranteed earnings.
